classiccrates.token.tooltip.item: Hold in your main hand with the item to change in your off hand, then right-click
classiccrates.token.tooltip.trail: Right-click to wear this particle trail
classiccrates.token.need_offhand: Hold the item you want to change in your off hand.
classiccrates.token.trail_on: You are now wearing the %s trail. Use /cosmetic trail off to remove it.
classiccrates.crate.need_key: You need a Crate Key. Vote for the server to get one!
classiccrates.crate.broadcast: %s opened a Vote Crate and won %s!
classiccrates.crate.empty: The crate was empty. (The crate loot table gave nothing; tell an admin.)
classiccrates.vote.thanks: Thanks for voting on %s! You received %s Crate Key(s).
classiccrates.vote.broadcast: %s voted for the server on %s and received a Crate Key!
classiccrates.vote.pending: You voted while you were away: here are %s Crate Key(s).

classiccrates.command.nothing_to_unskin: The item in your hand has no cosmetic.
classiccrates.token.hint_anvil: Combine with a matching item in an anvil (or hold the item in your off hand and right-click)
classiccrates.token.hint_trail: Right-click to wear this particle trail
classiccrates.phone.layout_installed: Switchyard touch controls are now in your launcher. To use them: launcher Settings, custom controls, Load, Switchyard-controls.
classiccrates.menu.title: Switchyard
classiccrates.menu.confirm.unclaim: Give up your claim on the chunk you are standing in?
classiccrates.menu.confirm.sethome: Set your home here? This replaces the home you have now.
classiccrates.menu.confirm.unskin: Take the skin off the item in your hand? The cosmetic token is not given back.
classiccrates.menu.crates.note: Crate Keys in your inventory: %s. Each vote gives a key; use it on the Vote Crate in the Citadel plaza.
classiccrates.menu.cosmetics.note: To wear a skin, combine its token with a matching item in an anvil.
classiccrates.menu.rules.note: No PvP inside the Citadel walls. Outside them, PvP and raiding are part of the game, so claim the chunks you build in. The full rules are on the website.
classiccrates.phone.hint.title: Touch controls installed
classiccrates.phone.hint.body: The Switchyard touch layout (Yard button, scroll, inventory-friendly) is now in your launcher, but it is not switched on yet. To turn it on: leave the game, open the launcher Settings, then Custom controls, tap Load and choose Switchyard-controls, and set it as the default. Then start the game again. Until then, everything is still reachable from the Switchyard button on the pause menu.
classiccrates.menu.confirm.land_pay: Pay the next land upkeep with the diamonds you carry? Diamond blocks count as 9.
classiccrates.menu.land.note: Claim covers the whole chunk you stand in, from bedrock to sky. Your land grows with hours played; the first week is free, then upkeep is paid in diamonds.
classiccrates.menu.players.note: Tap a player to ask to teleport to them or bring them to you. Teleports have a 5 second warm-up, then a 60 second cooldown.
classiccrates.menu.player.note: The other player gets a request in chat and can accept or deny it within 60 seconds.
classiccrates.menu.no_players: Nobody else is online right now.
classiccrates.menu.shortcuts.note: Screens that need a key on a PC. On a phone the same buttons are on the Switchyard touch layout.
classiccrates.menu.key_missing: %s is not installed in this pack.
classiccrates.menu.admin.note: Operators only. Every tile runs the usual command, and the server checks the permission again.
classiccrates.menu.admin.world.note: Tap a rule to switch it. Day and night, clear and rain take effect at once.
classiccrates.menu.admin.world.old: This server runs an older Classic Crates, so rule states cannot be shown here. Tapping a rule prints its value in chat.
classiccrates.menu.admin.players.note: Tap a player for teleport, kick, ban, game mode, kit and land.
classiccrates.menu.confirm.ban: Ban %s from the server? Undo later with /pardon %s.
